paite: Pathian in hon hehpih henla, hon vualzawl henla, amel i tung uah hon vaksak hen. Selah
heading: Kipahthu Genna La
english: For the Chief Musician. With stringed instruments. A Psalm. A song. May God be merciful to us, bless us, and cause his face to shine on us. Selah.

paite: Na lampi leitung a mi theih ahihtheih a, na hotdamna nam chih kiang a theih ahihtheihna ding in.
english: That your way may be known on earth, and your salvation among all nations,

paite: Pathian aw, michih in hon phat hen; mi khempeuhte'n hon phat hen.
english: let the peoples praise you, God. Let all the peoples praise you.

paite: Aw, namte kipaktak a om in, nopla sa uhen; nang michih khentuam nei lou a vai hawmsak in, leitung a namte na uk ngal a. Selah
english: Oh let the nations be glad and sing for joy, for you will judge the peoples with equity, and govern the nations on earth. Selah.

paite: Pathian aw, michih in hon phat uhen; mi chitengte'n hon phat uhen.
english: Let the peoples praise you, God. Let all the peoples praise you.

paite: Lei in athilpou apia a; Pathian, koumau Pathian ngei in, ahon vualzawl ding.
english: The earth has yielded its increase. God, even our own God, will bless us.

paite: Pathian in hon vualzawl ding a; kawlmong a mi tengteng in leng amah alau ding uhi.
english: God will bless us. All the ends of the earth shall fear him.
